title: Army Special Forces graduate first batch of Robotics Technician Integrators, a new job the rest of the service is eyeing
summary: Ten warrant officers graduated from the Robotics Technician Integrator (390A) course in a ceremony at Fort Bragg, North Carolina on Friday, marking the official start of the new job skill and culmination of an initial pilot program the rest of the Army is eyeing. The post Army Special Forces graduate first batch of Robotics Technician Integrators, a new job the rest of the service is eyeing appeared first on DefenseScoop .
